purpose: Quantify how closely the full frozen CLASS standard-sector background can be represented by one conserved pressureless effective fluid over the same late-time H3 window, without yet accepting that approximation.

standard_background_definition.density: rho_std = rho_b + rho_g + rho_ur + sum rho_ncdm
standard_background_definition.vacuum: rho_lambda excluded from rho_std and from clustering denominator

dust_consistency_diagnostics.best_constant_dust_fit: C_star = mean(C) over all native background rows in the window
dust_consistency_diagnostics.best_fit_density_error: rho_dust=C_star/a^3 versus rho_std, report global L2 and max pointwise relative error
dust_consistency_diagnostics.continuity_residual: d ln rho_std/d ln a + 3, evaluated numerically and compared descriptively with -3 w_std

outputs: same quantities at the eight frozen H3 audit redshifts
inferred AeST background pressure from total pressure budget as a provenance check
claim_boundary: PASS validates the background decomposition and dust-consistency diagnostics only. It does not accept the effective-dust approximation or license Z20.
anti_tuning: Do not introduce an approximation-acceptance threshold into GE17 after seeing the output.
